page.metaDescription: Technical support and pilot onboarding for BCSentinel in Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central.
page.title: Resolve technical issues faster with the right context.
page.lead: Support helps with concrete incidents, access problems, scan questions, and guided pilot onboarding. General product, pricing, and demo enquiries belong on the contact page.

heroAside.title: Check first
heroAside.text: Review the connection test, scan history, product status, and access snapshot.

heroAside.title: Include technical context
heroAside.text: Provide BC version, environment, company, run ID, timestamp, and exact error message.

heroAside.title: Protect sensitive data
heroAside.text: Do not send passwords, complete tokens, or unnecessary personal data.

sections.title: What technical support covers.
sections.lead: The channel is intended for reproducible technical and access-related issues.

cards.title: Connection and registration
cards.text: HTTPS/API connection, tenant registration, company mapping, or access-snapshot errors.

cards.title: Scans and run lifecycle
cards.text: Runs that do not start, remain active, fail, or show unclear status transitions.

cards.title: Results and report
cards.text: Missing findings, an empty dashboard, an unavailable report, or unexpected result display.

cards.title: Products and access
cards.text: Assessment, Validation, or Monitoring activation, credits, and access-window questions.

sections.title: These details enable focused analysis.
sections.lead: A complete technical description reduces follow-up questions and speeds up diagnosis.

cards.title: System context
cards.text: Business Central version, environment, affected company, and extension version.

cards.title: Time and reference
cards.text: Timestamp with time zone, run ID, finding code, report ID, or checkout reference where available.

cards.title: Observed error
cards.text: Provide exact wording, HTTP status, and visible state; send screenshots only without sensitive content.

cards.title: Reproduction steps
cards.text: Briefly describe the action, expected result, and actual result.

sections.title: Run these four checks first.
sections.lead: Many causes can be narrowed down directly in Business Central.

cards.title: 1. Connection test
cards.text: Verify API URL, HTTPS availability, and registered tenant context.

cards.title: 2. Scan history
cards.text: Review run status, latest heartbeat, start and end time, and error message.

cards.title: 3. License refresh
cards.text: Reload product status, credits, and access window from the backend.

cards.title: 4. Reopen the result
cards.text: Open dashboard or report again with current access and rule out a stale browser view.

sections.title: Describe the impact clearly.
sections.lead: BCSentinel currently publishes no fixed public SLA. A factual impact description still supports prioritization.

cards.title: Blocking
cards.text: Registration, scanning, or paid access is completely unavailable for the affected customer.

cards.title: Degraded
cards.text: A core function is impaired while an alternative path or partial functionality remains available.

cards.title: Question or display issue
cards.text: A content question, unexpected metric, or visual problem without a blocked workflow.

sections.title: Use the right channel for each request.
sections.lead: Choose the channel based on the type of request, not only its urgency.

cards.title: Technical support
cards.text: Use the contact form with Support selected or email support@bcsentinel.com for concrete technical cases.

cards.title: Pilot and onboarding
cards.text: For guided setup, sandbox acceptance, and support during the first customer scan.

cards.title: Product, demo, and pricing
cards.text: Use the contact page for commercial or general product questions.

cards.title: Partnership
cards.text: Use partner registration or the contact page for referral, commission, and cooperation questions.
